hazards.reason: OrderLine.quantity changes from INTEGER to REAL: the cast truncates or rounds values REAL cannot hold exactly.
hazards.subject: table/order_line/column/quantity

hazards.reason: Copying order_line holds the database's write lock for time that grows with the table.
hazards.subject: table/order_line

hazards.reason: OrderLine.quantity changes from INTEGER to REAL: servers built from the previous version still read and write INTEGER.
hazards.subject: table/order_line/column/quantity

hazards.reason: SQLite's ALTER TABLE cannot change the type of quantity, so the step rebuilds order_line: it copies the rows into a new table, drops the old one and renames the new one.
hazards.subject: table/order_line

statements:
CREATE TABLE "_new_order_line" (
  "id" TEXT DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(4)) || '-' || hex(randomblob(2)) || '-4' || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || substr('89ab', 1 + (random() & 3), 1) || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || hex(randomblob(6)))) NOT NULL,
  "sku" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "quantity" REAL NOT NULL,
  "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("order_id") REFERENCES "order" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE
)

INSERT INTO "_new_order_line" ("id", "sku", "quantity", "order_id")
SELECT "id", "sku", CAST("quantity" AS REAL), "order_id"
FROM "order_line"
steps.subject: table/order_line
